parameters.name: alertinfo
parameters.value:
## PROD incident: approve isolation + replacement?

- incident: $triage.body.incident_id
- pod: $triage.body.namespace/$triage.body.pod
- first alert: $triage.body.rule ($triage.body.priority)
- evidence archive sha256: $collect.body.record.archive_sha256

Approve = quarantine the pod, cut its connections, start a clean replacement, then delete it.

name: IR - Juice Shop response
description: Falco alert -> triage/correlate -> evidence -> dev: automatic isolation + replacement; prod: human approval first. Actions via ir-responder.
